scope: Fixed-corpus implementation performance, not new retrieval-quality selection
correctness: Require exactly identical chunk IDs, scores and order for every saved query on both indexes before timing. No change to corpus, chunks, query set, BM25 parameters or quality gates.
timing: time.perf_counter per search, excludes index construction and correctness comparison; warmed once over all queries; shuffled arm order per round and identical shuffled query order per pair. Record all per-query seconds. Extra O(V+N) index memory is not measured RSS.
decision: Report both indexes and all rounds; no parameter tuning or index reselection. Historical holdout is reused only to verify exact implementation equivalence.
